gaps.lead: 'Have you seen my keys anywhere?' he asked us.
gaps.sentence: He asked us ___ his keys anywhere.
gaps.explanation: if/whether + subject + backshifted verb: whether we had seen.

gaps.lead: His trainers were so worn out that they had holes in them.
gaps.sentence: His trainers were ___ they had holes in them.
gaps.explanation: so worn out = in such bad condition.

gaps.lead: Even though she was exhausted after twelve hours on duty, the surgeon completed the operation.
gaps.sentence: ___ exhausted after twelve hours on duty, the surgeon completed the operation.
gaps.explanation: 'Even though she was' becomes 'in spite of being' — concession + gerund.

gaps.lead: 'Did you send the invoice?' the manager asked her.
gaps.explanation: if/whether + subject + backshifted verb: whether she had sent.

gaps.lead: I can't wait for the holidays to start.
gaps.explanation: look forward TO + -ing: the 'to' is a preposition.
